notes.title: Join Let it Boom playtest 💣
notes.content:
Hey there, chaos addicts!

We have prepared a playtest version of the [b]Let it Boom[/b] tutorial as we crave your feedback. 

[h3]For those who are interested in playing, here are some instructions:[/h3]

🚀request access by clicking the "Request Access" button on the page 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42681883/fb0fa72dd81ae7bcbd3fe66f7fda4eb6a6169c7f.png[/img]

🚀have fun in the game
🚀join our [url=https://discord.gg/XQdJfmKVWy]Discord[/url]
🚀share your honest feedback with us there, or fill out [url=https://forms.gle/tdNvkZ2VnfCWYAb36]a tiny little survey[/url]

[i]The playtest will be open till May 3 10:00 am PDT[/i]

Hope to hear from you soon 🌹

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1951500/Let_It_Boom/

notes.title: Status update 💣
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42681883/609136f7bbe2fe8796a15dd07d245e0c88db9176.gif[/img]

[h3]Hello, everyone![/h3]

Firstly, we wanted to thank everyone who paid attention to our game, played the ordinary and Halloween edition demos, shared [url=https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=let+it+boom+vr+]all the videos[/url], [url=https://thevrdimension.com/sometimes-you-just-need-a-little-boom-in-your-life/10/26/2022/]publications[/url] and added Let it Boom to their wishlist!

Overall, this post is a small status update, we just wanted to let you know that we are not going on hiatus, but instead continuing our work and are planning to break into a first half of 2023 with the new build full of explosion and destruction.

In the recent weeks, the team had fun making a stationary cannon, prototyping future explosive (of course!) puzzles and working on a very familiar for VR distant grab feature.

That’s all for now, stay tuned for the future posts, folks!
